description.value: A Travelodge by Wyndham situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, a key stop in the Shuswap region for cyclists travelling between Vancouver and the Rockies. As a highway motor hotel, it offers straightforward roadside accommodation in a town with reasonable access to services. Salmon Arm sits roughly midway along the Trans-Canada corridor, making it a natural overnight break for loaded touring cyclists.
